Built-in ImageGen edit, 2 November 2026. Input: mordren-ashen-host.png.
Output: mordren-rig-v1.png. Native transparency retained. Two horizontal atlas regions, body on left and axe/forearm on right. The renderer calibrates the independently sized regions around a shoulder pivot; this is an articulated 2D composite, not a 3D skeletal model or video.

Prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production 2D skeletal animation texture atlas for existing painted fantasy card-game character Mordren. Edit target is supplied transparent character. Preserve EXACT badger identity, face, black iron armor, furnace in chest, orange fire, proportions and painted style. Output a landscape/square atlas consisting of TWO equal vertical panels side by side with fully transparent backgrounds and absolutely no text, no dividing line. Both panels represent the SAME original full portrait canvas, same character scale and registration coordinates. LEFT PANEL: character body, head, chest furnace, lower cloak, forward reaching hand, but REMOVE the entire raised axe and its gripping hand/raised forearm on viewer LEFT; repair underlying shoulder/armor with natural painted armor and no hole. Keep the face and reaching hand identical. Do not leave an axe duplicate in left panel. RIGHT PANEL: ONLY that removed raised axe plus gripping glove and raised armored forearm; isolated at their original registered positions in this panel. All remaining character/body pixels in right panel transparent. Keep fire along axe edge but reduce diffuse fire behind the detached arm so it composites cleanly. Each panel has 8% clear padding so axe is never cut off. Atlas must assemble to the original character when right panel overlays left panel. High detail original painting; no new weapons, no pose change, no scenery, no checkerboard, genuinely transparent alpha.
